chapter: Back in New York: Heard and Dizzy
title: Leaving Dizzy to lead his own band
summary: Soon after returning he formed his own group, taking small jobs and learning to get work and be a business man before the Paradise.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: So you returned to this country. Were you still with Dizzy after that?

Yeah, not much longer after that. And what I decided then that I should get my own band, you know what I mean. I got my own band and started workin' little jobs and I began to learn about how to get a job and things was a new experience and bein' a leader, you know what I mean.
This was, in fact, the first time was it that you had been a leader?
Yeah...decided to. And I played little jobs, but...
Who did you have with you?

Well, various guys at different times. It might be Monk, sometimes, and it might be Art Blakely (sic) or who ever was available. Everybody was here and you got a job, let's go make it, you know. So that's the way that happened.
What were some of the jobs that you got?

Well, let's see if I can remember....I really, actually, don't remember. But I remember the important job. At the Paradise. But before that I don't remember some of those jobs that I played. Mostly before that, up until the time of the Paradise, I was playing with sombody else, mostly. But I did little jobs, which didn't mean anything, like a club date here or a dance there. But I was learning, you know, how to be a business man and get around and do. And I did some dates at Birdland, you know, and 52nd Street, you
know what I mean, and then the Paradise was the job.
